summary: Diff adds admin-editable muscle group card management (new backend types/state + migration + Creator Dashboard UI) and adds an admin-only “Manage Blog” navigation button on the public Blog page. Exercise management validation appears relaxed to accept any non-empty URLs (including external URLs). However, the diff summary does not provide enough evidence that the backend exposes the required muscle-group-card CRUD/query methods with admin-only authorization, nor that exercise preview cards implement an image fallback when missing/unreachable.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend support for persisting and serving admin-managed muscle-group card content with admin-only update permissions (query/get + update endpoints, authorization enforcement).
missing_requirements.reason: While backend state/types and a migration are shown, the diff summary is truncated and does not show any public canister methods to get/update muscle group cards, nor any explicit admin-only authorization checks around those methods.
evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (calls actor.getMuscleGroupArtists/getMuscleGroupArtist/updateMuscleGroupArtist, but backend methods are not evidenced)

missing_requirements.requirement: Workout Library exercise preview cards continue to display each exercise’s imageUrl with a sensible fallback if missing/unreachable.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows muscle-group card image fallbacks, and ExerciseManagement requires imageUrl/videoUrl be non-empty, but the truncated WorkoutLibraryPage does not provide evidence of a fallback behavior for exercise preview images specifically (e.g., onError handling or placeholder image).

hallucinated_features.description: Introduces a new optional `heroImage : ?Storage.ExternalBlob` field for muscle group cards and corresponding blob-storage integration/migration scaffolding.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-14 only requires admin-managed image URL and description (minimum), and does not request blob-stored hero images or external blob fields for muscle group cards.
